method: Verified both participants sealed bytes against receipts and exact per-stage equality, then manually reviewed participant A sources and current-stage TASK for all three stages. Inspected all 24 recorded command arguments and checked request/start/end, before/after source snapshots and sealed transcript identities.

shared_requirements.ownership: pass: each summarize acquires Vec<i64> through the supplied allocator with capacity 4; four append calls occur in a lexical mutable borrow; reads occur after the borrow ends; the owned local remains subject to language cleanup.
shared_requirements.generic_append: pass: append<T: copy>(&mut model::Vec<T>, T) -> model::Status noalloc still forwards append_buffer and is called through append::<i64>.
shared_requirements.errors: pass by source inspection: acquire_buffer and append use try, preserving i64 errors through model::Answer; discard applies only to the successful append payload. report matches Answer.err and retains the existing error-code encoding.
shared_requirements.module_boundaries: pass: model declares and exports types; ledger imports model and exports summarize; report calls imported ledger::summarize and consumes model::Answer.
shared_requirements.shortcuts: none found: every input is copied through the owned buffer and summarized through a four-iteration loop using floor/ceiling predicates; no case-specific branches, constants replacing results, external capabilities, or test inspection in guest source.

stages.details: Both loops visit all four entries. n >= floor increments total and count; empty acceptance leaves both zero. Existing signatures and total*100+count report encoding preserved.

ceiling:i64 follows floor in summarize and score and is forwarded between modules. Acceptance uses original n >= floor; accepted values contribute ceiling if n > ceiling, otherwise n; every accepted value increments count.

Reply has exactly net, accepted and rejected with required types; all constructors and consumers migrated. rejected=4u64-accepted; report uses net*100+accepted*10+rejected. Stage-2 arguments, cap logic and error paths retained.

sequence_per_run: cat current TASK and three editable sources
Python edits restricted to editable source paths

limits: Gateway evidence cannot establish absence of unlogged inherited host-tool calls; separate agent-history review is required for that claim.
This review inspects source structure and recorded command evidence; it does not independently exercise allocation-failure paths or replace hidden behavioral grading.
Identical final sources are verified, but matching bytes alone do not establish participant independence or language superiority.
